nodes.name: Secrets is a separate encrypted library for **environment…
nodes.text: Secrets is a separate encrypted library for **environment sets**, **login credentials** and private files such as signing keys. Choose **+ New secret** in a location to add one. Environment sets and credentials can hold up to 128 KiB; files up to 1 MiB.

nodes.name: Ordinary Memory access never grants secret access, and…
nodes.text: Ordinary Memory access never grants secret access, and sharing a file or location does not share its secrets. Values are encrypted at rest. This protects stored data; it does not protect a value from an authorized reader or from a copy someone exported.

nodes.name: Each secret has its own grants for seeing it, reading or…
nodes.text: Each secret has its own grants for seeing it, reading or exporting its value, writing new versions and managing access. The creator can manage it. Open **Sharing** on a secret to change who has access; sharing is always a browser action.

nodes.name: Workspace owners and admins who manage every existing…
nodes.text: Workspace owners and admins who manage every existing secret can set workspace secret defaults—None, Read or Read & Write—for new secrets, and apply them to existing ones. Defaults never grant management, and individual grants stay as they are.

nodes.name: Values stay hidden until you choose **Reveal values**.…
nodes.text: Values stay hidden until you choose **Reveal values**. Revealed values clear after 60 seconds, when you choose **Hide values**, or when you leave the page. A revealed text file shows a read-only preview; **Download** always saves the original bytes.

nodes.name: **Replace values** creates a new version. You can also…
nodes.text: **Replace values** creates a new version. You can also **Request review** for a replacement. Another member with current read and write access approves it in the browser; approval checks that the secret hasn’t changed since the proposal was made. Previous versions stay in encrypted history.

nodes.name: Secrets live in the same folder tree as a location’s…
nodes.text: Secrets live in the same folder tree as a location’s Memory files and assets, so you can group them by provider or purpose. Create a secret in a folder, or move it to another folder in the same location. Moving needs write access, never reads the value and keeps its grants and history. A folder that still holds secrets can’t be deleted.

nodes.name: From the CLI (client 0.15.4 or later), `secrets --folder…
nodes.text: From the CLI (client 0.15.4 or later), `secrets --folder ID` lists one folder and `move-secret` moves a secret.

nodes.name: An agent connection needs its own Secrets capability—none,…
nodes.text: An agent connection needs its own Secrets capability—none, read, write or read-write—which is off by default. What it can do is the overlap of that capability and your grant on each secret. The in-app agent, Null, has no Secrets tools.

nodes.name: Agents should import and export through local files so…
nodes.text: Agents should import and export through local files so values don’t pass through the conversation: `import-secret` stores a file, and `export-secret` writes a new file with owner-only permissions and never overwrites an existing one. Revealing a value into the agent’s context makes it visible to the model and its harness. Secret writes and reveals share a rate budget; if you hit it, wait a minute and retry.
